summary: Settlement amounts are now rounded to the currency's minor unit instead of truncated. The rounding is Math.round, which rounds halves up.

claims.text: Fractions of a minor unit are no longer dropped.
claims.evidence: toMinor(10.019, "USD") returns 1001 on base and 1002 on head. The new test passes on head and fails on base.

claims.text: Rounding uses banker's rounding, as the settlement spec requires.
claims.evidence: Math.round rounds halves up. toMinor(0.125, "USD") returns 13; banker's rounding gives 12. docs/settlement.md section 3 says "round half to even".

sections.title: The rounding change
sections.why: One line that changes every settlement amount with a fractional minor unit.

sections.title: Tests
sections.proof: Passes on head, fails on base. It does not cover an exact half.

decisions.title: Halves round up, not to even.
decisions.detail: The description and docs/settlement.md both say banker's rounding. Math.round rounds 0.5 up, so amounts ending in exactly half a minor unit come out one unit high about half the time.
decisions.question: Should this hold to banker's rounding before it merges?

options.label: Yes, block
options.detail: The spec says round half to even.
options.comment: `Math.round` rounds halves up; docs/settlement.md section 3 requires round half to even. `toMinor(0.125, "USD")` returns 13 and should return 12. Please use a half-even rounding and add a test for an exact half.

options.label: Half up is fine
options.detail: Then the spec and description should change.
options.comment: Accepting half-up rounding. Please update docs/settlement.md and the description, which both say banker's rounding.

options.label: I do not know
options.comment: Is half-up rounding intended? The description says banker's rounding, but `Math.round` rounds halves up: `toMinor(0.125, "USD")` is 13, not 12.
